description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell from exile by paying one mana, unpreparing Pigment Wrangler // Striking Palette.
When you cast this, Displacer Kitten and Birgi, God of Storytelling triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten ability, flickering Pigment Wrangler // Striking Palette, which enters prepared.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
